subject: physics
topic: Atomic and nuclear physics: radioactivity and half-life

kept.q: Which of the following radioactive emissions has the greatest ionizing power but the least penetrating power, being stopped by a thin sheet of paper or a few centimetres of air?
kept.explanation: Alpha particles are heavy and carry a +2 charge, so they interact strongly with matter and ionize it a lot, but this also makes them lose energy quickly and get stopped easily, even by paper. Beta and gamma radiations penetrate further but ionize less per collision.
kept.pidgin: Alpha particle dey heavy well-well and get +2 charge, so e dey ionize matter plenty, but e dey lose energy quick so paper fit stop am. Beta and gamma dey waka pass am but dem no too ionize reach alpha.

kept.q: A radioactive isotope used in a Lagos teaching hospital has an initial mass of 800 g. If its half-life is 6 hours, what mass of the isotope remains after 18 hours, assuming no other process removes the material?
kept.explanation: 18 hours divided by the half-life of 6 hours gives 3 half-lives. After each half-life the mass halves, so 800 g becomes 400 g, then 200 g, then 100 g after 3 half-lives.
kept.pidgin: 18 hours divide by 6 hours half-life na 3 half-lives. Every half-life the mass dey cut by half: 800 to 400, 400 to 200, 200 to 100 g after the third one.

kept.q: The half-life of a certain radioactive substance is 20 days. Using ln 2 = 0.693, calculate its decay constant correct to 3 decimal places.
kept.explanation: The decay constant is given by lambda = ln2 / half-life = 0.693 / 20 = 0.0347, which rounds to 0.035 per day to 3 decimal places.
kept.pidgin: Decay constant na lambda = ln2 divide by half-life = 0.693/20 = 0.0347, wey round go 0.035 per day for 3 decimal places.

kept.q: An archaeologist found a wooden carving from an old settlement near Ile-Ife whose carbon-14 activity is only 12.5% of the activity measured in a freshly cut piece of the same type of wood. If the half-life of carbon-14 is 5730 years, estimate the age of the carving.
kept.explanation: 12.5% equals 1/8, and (1/2)^3 = 1/8, so 3 half-lives have passed. Age = 3 x 5730 years = 17190 years.
kept.pidgin: 12.5% na 1/8, and (1/2) raise to 3 na 1/8, so na 3 half-lives don pass. Age = 3 x 5730 years = 17190 years.
